description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of video content categories, likely from a dataset used in the paper “Enhancing Multimodal LLM for Detailed and Accurate Video Captioning using Multi-Round Preference Optimization.” The chart is divided into twelve distinct slices, each labeled with a category and its corresponding percentage share. The largest segment is “People Blogs” at 17.2%, followed by “Entertainment” at 13.9% and “Education” at 9.7%. Other notable categories include “Sports” (7.7%), “Gaming” (6.4%), “Science Technology” (6.4%), “Comedy” (5.6%), and “Howto” (4.6%). Smaller segments include “Film Animation” (4.6%), “Travel Events” (4.6%), “News Politics” (4.3%), “Pets Animals” (3.9%), “Autos Vehicles” (4.8%), and “Music” (2.3%). Each slice is color-coded and labeled with its percentage, and the chart includes a legend to associate each color with its category. The segments appear to be arranged in a roughly descending order by size, starting from the largest at the top right and proceeding clockwise.
